verdict.rationale: Workable's features page says a single submission posts a job to 200+ job boards at once, which covers the core fan-out of the story. The evidence does not name LinkedIn, Indeed or specific aggregators, and says nothing about managing sponsored or paid posts inside the ATS. Missing for 10: confirmation of LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator coverage, sponsored-post budgeting and management in the ATS, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
